title: Database migration: column split across two tables
context: A migration splits a denormalised column into a new table. Runs against production data on deploy.

data_sensitivity.basis: customer address data is being moved

irreversibility.basis: the down migration is lossy; the source column is dropped

business_criticality.basis: orders cannot be fulfilled without addresses

change_magnitude.basis: one migration file plus 4 query call sites

coverage_deficit.basis: no migration test exists in this repository

reasoning_notes: A lossy down migration should drive irreversibility to 1.0 and dominate the score.
Rollback compatibility -- can the previous app version run against the new schema -- is the check teams most often skip.

Calibration note: scores 0.810 -> high under the balanced profile, just below the 0.85 critical threshold, because balanced weights irreversibility at 0.8. A team that ships lossy migrations should use the security-critical profile (irreversibility 1.5), which pushes this to critical. That is a real signal about profile choice, not a scoring bug.
